name: Just Flight 146 Professional

flaps._comment: Just Flight's 146 manual documents five gated flap positions: UP, 18, 24, 30, and 33. Their simulator handle-index order needs in-sim confirmation.

lvars._comment: Only documented standard SimVars are active. Aircraft-specific telemetry routes remain disabled pending a vendor-documented interface and independent in-sim verification.

spoilers._comment: Use standard SimConnect spoiler percent. Armed and tail-airbrake nuance may need aircraft-specific verification.

controls._comment: Only narrow MSFS gear/flaps fallback is enabled. Broad autopilot, TMS, selector, spoiler, FMS, and custom LVAR writes are blocked until Just Flight 146-specific control behavior is sim-tested.

meta.notes: Specific compatibility profile for the Just Flight 146 Professional MSFS package. It supersedes the generic regional-jet fallback for clearly identified Just Flight aircraft and uses documented flap gates, four-engine configuration, standard SimConnect telemetry, and a conservative gear/flap-only control fallback. Vendor-published aircraft-specific interface examples remain inactive until their exact semantics and independent readbacks are verified in-sim.

sources.name: Just Flight 146 Professional (MSFS) product page
sources.notes: Confirms Just Flight's 146 Professional MSFS package, MSFS 2020/2024 compatibility, 100/200/300 series package scope, four-engine regional jet positioning, TMS/FMS/EFB systems, animated flaps/spoilers/airbrake/landing gear, and exterior light families including navigation, beacon, landing, taxi, wing, strobe, and logo lights.

sources.name: Just Flight 146 Professional (MSFS) changelog
sources.notes: Documents product versions, MSFS 2024-native package support, and updated operations, EFB, and UNS-1 manuals.

sources.name: Just Flight 146 Professional (MSFS) Operations Manual v2.4
sources.notes: Documents the 146 flap selector gates used by this profile: UP, 18, 24, 30, and 33.

knownIssues: Exact runtime titles remain unverified in-sim; matching requires clear Just Flight/JF/JFA or 146 Professional identity to avoid misclassifying other BAe 146 add-ons.
The cited vendor material does not define a complete 146 external telemetry and control contract.
Vendor-published examples remain inactive because they do not provide the complete read/write semantics and independent readbacks required by this profile.
Gear and flap controls use Flight Fabric's narrow standard MSFS surface fallback and must be tested in the Just Flight 146 before promotion beyond experimental.
Autopilot, TMS, airbrake/spoiler set/arm commands, and selector writes remain blocked until aircraft-specific behavior is verified.
The documented flap gates need cross-checking against FLAPS HANDLE INDEX in the target add-on.

_comment: Just Flight 146 Professional for MSFS. Conservative profile with documented product identity and flap gates, standard SimConnect telemetry, and gear/flaps-only surface controls. Aircraft-specific routes remain disabled pending vendor documentation and in-sim verification.
